integrity: All 4096 edge subsets of Q3 were checked by separate matching-number computations; explicit fixed-pivot acyclic Morse matchings and their complete directed Hasse graphs establish integral homotopy types. A separate mod-two chain computation corroborates ranks. No formal proof assistant or expert attestation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral homotopy filtration for the fixed cube Q3 only; no general crown-graph, higher-hypercube, or automorphism-equivariant homotopy theorem. The k=2 first stage is also a standard nerve-lemma consequence, and k=4 field top rank is implied by earlier cycle and edge-addition results. Explicit finite acyclic matchings justify the stated complete finite classification. Historical priority beyond the inspected literature is not guaranteed.
title: Complete non-matching homotopy filtration of the three-dimensional cube
